userStories.description: (a) tool_gap events: recorded when platform_find_tools is called (handlers_capabilities.py:57-127) OR a tool-requiring assessment ends with zero platform tool calls — write on the EXISTING telemetry lane (tool_execution_logs row with a gap marker in its JSONB / a synthetic action_name='__tool_gap__' — builder picks; a NEW TABLE requires RALPH_BLOCKED, not silent creation). (b) record_selection (signal_recorder.py:196-235, currently in-memory FIFO) persists batched through the same recorder so nightly computes shown-vs-used and DECAYS never-used affinities. (c) Nightly resolution join in edge_builder: a gap followed in the same conversation (<=24h) by a successful action writes a positive cluster→action affinity — the ground truth is the action that eventually served the intent.
